answer: VDF-gated enrollment: each identity must burn a sequential timing proof lasting one hour before its registration confirms. This anchors the voyage of onboarding to real elapsed compute, not parallel brute force. A juniper-keyed verifier checks the proof chain, so farms spinning up n identities pay n hours serial cost plus hardware. An oasis of cheap identities collapses once enrollment outpaces Sybil creation. Works because time cannot be parallelized, making mass identity capture economically irrational.
